description: This Java source file defines the class MethodSourcer, a subclass of ASM's MethodVisitor, which generates Java source code for a method during bytecode analysis. It includes logic to produce method headers, handle annotations, and stub method bodies, primarily used in generating stub implementations from bytecode.

classes.name: MethodSourcer
classes.description: A custom ASM MethodVisitor that generates Java source code for methods found during bytecode analysis, handling method headers, annotations, and stub bodies.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Generates the method's signature including modifiers, return type, parameters, and exceptions, and writes it to the output.

methods.name: visitCode
methods.description: Invoked when the method's bytecode is about to be visited; writes the method header and a stub body.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Completes the method visitation by writing closing braces.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Handles method annotations, writing their descriptions.

methods.name: visitMethodInsn
methods.description: Handles method invocation instructions, currently pass-through.
